name: spi_two_point_equilibrium_pinned
lines: N S : ℕ
hS : 2 ≤ S
x w : Fin N → Fin 2 → ℝ
hinst : spi_is_two_point_instance x w
T : ℝ
φ : Fin N → Fin 2 → Fin S → ℝ
heq : spi_is_equilibrium x w T φ
i : Fin N
hr : 0 < spi_reach_prob x w φ T i
⊢ spi_accept_prob x w φ T i = spi_two_point_max_prob (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T ∧
spi_accept_value x w φ T i = spi_two_point_max_value (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T
hlh : x i 1 ≤ x i 0
hw1 : w i 1 = 1 - w i 0
hb :
spi_accept_prob x w φ T i ≤ spi_two_point_max_prob (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T ∧
(spi_two_point_max_prob (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T ≤ spi_accept_prob x w φ T i →
spi_accept_value x w φ T i = spi_two_point_max_value (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T)
hsch : spi_is_scheme (spi_two_point_scheme S (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T)
hval :
∀ (φ : Fin N → Fin 2 → Fin S → ℝ),
φ i = spi_two_point_scheme S (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T →
spi_accept_prob x w φ T i = spi_two_point_max_prob (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T
hdev :
spi_player_payoff x w (Function.update φ i (spi_two_point_scheme S (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T)) T i ≤
spi_player_payoff x w φ T i
spi_reach_prob x w (Function.update φ i (spi_two_point_scheme S (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T)) T i *
spi_accept_prob x w (Function.update φ i (spi_two_point_scheme S (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T)) T i ≤
spi_reach_prob x w φ T i * spi_accept_prob x w φ T i
spi_reach_prob x w φ T i * spi_two_point_max_prob (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T ≤
hge : spi_two_point_max_prob (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T ≤ spi_accept_prob x w φ T i

steps.tactic: obtain ⟨-, hlh, h0, h1, hw1⟩ := hinst i
have hb := spi_two_point_bound x w φ T i hlh h0 h1 hw1 (heq.1 i)
obtain ⟨hsch, hval⟩ := spi_two_point_scheme_spec hS x w T i _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl hw1 hlh h0 h1
rw [spi_reach_prob_update, hval _ (Function.update_self i _ φ)] at hdev
have hge : spi_two_point_max_prob (x i 0) (x i 1) (w i 0) T ≤ spi_accept_prob x w φ T i := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hdev hr
